method: Assistant inspection of original-resolution final artifact PNGs using view_image
findings: The authored bloodstream intro environment and original cell assets render in the selected Timeline frame without missing-material panels or a blank screen.
The original CAP dialogue appears in the redesigned paper panel with a clear speaker label, legible source text, ink icon and fully visible Continue control at 1440 by 900.
At 960 by 600, the dialogue, keyboard hint and Continue control fit inside the viewport without clipping or overlap.
The original intro caption is visibly readable in light paper-colored type over the vessel scene; no dark-ink subtitle contrast regression is visible.
scope: Release intro/dialogue and 960 by 600 viewport visual review only; full-route, task-HUD, menu, crowd and audio acceptance are outside this audit.
limitations: Intro/dialogue and small-viewport review only. This does not certify the full route, task HUD, optional branches, settings/chat menus, minigame playability, continuous crowd behavior, audio, physical mobile devices or overall human difficulty/cinematography.
Exact cell placement, animation and subtitle activation timing differs between browser engines.
Startup NavMesh and browser GPU warnings remain recorded in acceptance.json; this is not a zero-warning claim.
2 narrowly identified loader cancellations are recorded; the loader resolved and the real release ran. Cancelled streams are not reported as successful downloads.
